corrected_answer: Assume one request, dense retention of the stated K/V heads for every layer and token, and nominal 2 byte(s) per BF16/FP16 value. Both K and V are stored, so the logical payload is 2 (K,V) x 48 layers x 2560 tokens x 8 KV heads x 128 dimensions x 2 bytes/value = 503,316,480 bytes = 0.468750 GiB (1 GiB = 2^30 bytes). This is a payload estimate, not a runtime-allocation guarantee: verify the deployed dtype, head convention, layout, padding, paging, retention/eviction, prefix sharing, batching, and any quantization metadata or packing. Weights, activations, workspaces, allocator fragmentation, and other requests are excluded. Measure allocated and reserved memory versus sequence length and concurrency, plus correctness, OOM/failure rate, prefill/decode latency, throughput, and tail latency on matched workloads before using the estimate for capacity planning.
